::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/reports/credit_deferred_revenue"}
#docs
Paid credit at its cost (what the buyer paid), per month in the business time zone, currency and unit (`money` for credit in money): opening + sold − recognised − breakage − refunds + other = closing, and a month's closing is the next month's opening. sold: paid credit that became spendable. recognised: credit used, less draws given back. breakage: credit that expired. refunds: credit voided by a credit note. other: rollovers between grants. Every customer counts, so the closing balances of a currency add up to `ledger_closing`. Credit invoiced and not yet paid is not included. Needs `credits:view`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | `string` | no | First month, YYYY-MM. Default: 11 months before `to`. |
| `to` | `string` | no | Last month, YYYY-MM. Default: this month. At most 36 months. |
| `currency` | `string` | no | Only this currency. |
| `unit` | `string` | no | Only this unit; `money` for credit in money. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `credit_deferred_revenue`. One of `credit_deferred_revenue`. |
| `time_zone` | `string` | The business time zone the months are cut in. |
| `from` | `string` | YYYY-MM. |
| `to` | `string` | YYYY-MM. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.month` | `string` | YYYY-MM. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. |
| `data.unit` | `string` | The credit unit; `money` for credit in money. |
| `data.opening_minor` | `integer` | Paid credit at cost at the start of the month. |
| `data.sold_minor` | `integer` | Paid credit that became spendable. |
| `data.recognised_minor` | `integer` | Credit used, less draws given back: moved to revenue. |
| `data.breakage_minor` | `integer` | Credit that expired unused. |
| `data.refunds_minor` | `integer` | Credit voided by a credit note. |
| `data.other_minor` | `integer` | Rollovers between grants. Usually 0. |
| `data.closing_minor` | `integer` | At the end of the month. |
| `data.credited_minor` | `integer` | What credit notes gave back on the packs this month, used credits included (a full refund). Not part of the balance above. |
| `ledger_closing` | `array of object` | The `credit_grants_paid` ledger account at the end of `to`, per currency. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The roll-forward. |
